style: cinematic 3D, Pixar-quality, dusty vest, hard hat, matte non-glossy, faint grain, deadpan slapstick
shot: vertical, waist-level static take on the piglet, locked off except one push-in on his face 7.6-9.6; bull large and close to lens from 3.2, frame never pulls back
character: PIGLET FOREMAN: businesslike pig, dry composure, dignity to the last; trotters grip/press/lift/flinch; upright throughout, back curves only in final beat; same design throughout
cast: BULL BANK COLLECTOR: large bull, necktie, briefcase, stamp always in his free hand, never set down; heavy torso jerks; close to lens from entrance; never speaks; same design throughout
props: form: sheet, ОДОБРЕНО stamp from the hook, gains a 2nd stamp at beat 7, never duplicated. brick: price tag on it, from the wheelbarrow, lifted/rotated by the piglet, set beside the ready row, thrown back into the wheelbarrow. trowel: in his trotter from beat 3. wheelbarrow: crashes in at beat 4, bolts at beat 10, clips the gravel pile. ready row, gravel, bucket: present since 0.0. No on-screen text except the stamp marks.
setting: bright sunny morning, open construction site, no walls or roof; pre-built brick row by a poured foundation; gravel pile at the yard's edge; overturned bucket nearby
lighting: hard bright morning sun as key light, crisp rim highlight from low sun behind camera-left, fully lit daylight

audio.delivery: male, low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry, businesslike deadpan, weary restraint, native Russian, no accent, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: three lines, ~5 syll/sec, no drawn-out words, 0.6s hold after each line
audio.lip_sync: piglet talks like a person, snout/jaw open-close each syllable, his own voice, never a voice over

timeline.a: Hook: shakes the form, ОДОБРЕНО stamp swings up, hard hat bounces
dry. Presses form to chest, rises on tiptoes
no gap. Lift finishes, spine straight
Holds the pose in silence; lays the form flat, picks up the trowel, smooths mortar on the foundation
Wheelbarrow crashes in, bull brakes hard, shoving the piglet's shoulder, muzzle huge at the lens; flips the side board, brick with its tag exposed
flat disbelief. Lifts the brick, one 180-degree rotation, eyes on the tag
Rotation finishes, brick held up in silence; bull snatches the form, slams his stamp
Piglet sets the brick beside the ready row, flush; bull grabs it, hurls it into the wheelbarrow
Wheelbarrow bolts, wheel clips the gravel pile, dust sprays the piglet; he rocks back, snaps the trowel up

timeline.line: Первый платёж — авансом (a-VAN-som — stress on the second syllable, never AVAN-som)
timeline.a: flat and dry, eyes on the lens; trowel lowers slowly
timeline.camera: only push-in begins here, tightening to end

timeline.a: Trowel settles on the foundation in silence; sits on the bucket, back curving first time, tracing the rim, pointless now

must_appear: ОДОБРЕНО stamp in the hook; brick rotated with its price tag; stamp struck on the form; brick thrown into the wheelbarrow; wheel clipping gravel, spraying the piglet; trowel lowering on the punchline
negative_prompt: night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody, low-key, dark scene; bricks stacking or assembling on camera, tiered construction, floating objects; duplicate brick, form, trowel, wheelbarrow, or stamp; stamp leaving his hand or set down; second piglet or bull, other animals, crowd, human hands; bull far from lens after entrance; camera moves besides the single push-in, zoom, pan, handheld shake, snap zoom; cuts; costume/appearance changes; extra limbs; slow speech, drawn-out delivery, English speech, foreign accent, wrong stress on авансом; subtitles, watermark, text overlay
